card.name: Small linking words in general prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, a, the, his, to, or a comma, right before a noun phrase in general essays on history, religion or society. It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Of/to after a noun
modes.description: The word of or to joins a noun to what follows in a moral or historical sentence.
modes.example: at the service<< of>> selfish interest and mere pleasure

modes.label: Articles and possessives
modes.description: The word a, the or his comes before a noun in a list or comparison.
modes.example: Rightful heir to the throne of Baden or<< a>> fraud?

modes.label: List commas and modifiers
modes.description: A comma or adjective sits inside a list of peoples or traditions.
modes.example: a second century fusion of Jewish, Greek<<,>> and Roman theology

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look like word beginnings such as statist, adher and mend.
card.plain: It marks little connecting words in ordinary essay text, just before the next noun is named.
